integrity: The exact rational checks supplement a complete written proof. Publication priority is limited to inspected material; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The all-coefficient criterion is proved only within the stated sufficient directed-edge chamber; at product one no stability statement is made. An interior periodic orbit is forced, but uniqueness, hyperbolicity, and precise location are unproved.
title: An exact square-polycycle threshold forcing an interior periodic orbit in a quartic flow
